tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// theg pa'i rnam dbye bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// theg pa'i rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems kyi gzhir brten nas// rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul gyis// bla med go 'phang legs brnyes pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// theg pa rnams kyi khyad par ni// shes nas ji bzhin rab spyad nas// sangs rgyas go 'phang thob 'dod pas// bskul ba'i don du 'di bshad do// gnas skabs kyi ni bde sdug la// blang dor byed pa phal pa ste// de yi don la blang dang dor// byed pa grub mthar zhugs pa yin// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// chos rnams thams cad bdag med la// zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal zhing*// mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba zhes// phyag rgya bzhi po khams 'che zhing*// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ba// de ni sangs rgyas pa yin te// de dang mi ldan phyi rol pa'o// nges 'byung tshul khrims gzhir brten nas// bden pa rnam pa bzhi dang ni// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs nas su// 'du 'dzi'i yul dang yid spangs nas// rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa dang*// ting 'dzin zhi ba'i lam brtson pas// gnas skabs kun nas ldang ba yi// yid ni nye bar zhi gyur pas// re zhig yang srid mi len pa// de ni theg pa chung ngu yin// lta ba bdag med gnyis ldan zhing*// snying rje chen po las byung ba'i// spyod pa gzhan don nyer bsgrubs la// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pa'i// bsgom pas rang yid dul byas nas// sa bcu dang ni lam lnga la// bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs par// brtson pas lam gyi rgyun gyi mthar// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// sgrib pa bag chags bcas spangs nas// bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa// sgrub byed pha rol phyin pa'i tshul// sngags kyi khyad par gzhag pa ni// slob dpon kṛ pi ka ma las// don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs dgongs pa'ang gsang sngags pas// byang chub sems dang stong nyid dang*// snying rje nyid ni lam gyi gzhir// dgongs pa'i phyir na don gcig pa// 'on kyang rnal 'byor chen po yis// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma las// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blang*// de tshe dbang gi ye shes kyis// lta ba dug med rtogs pas na// gzhi dang lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs// ma rmongs pa zhes bya ba ste// 'di ni khyad par dang po yin// rgya chen bskyed pa'i rim pa yis// lus dang skye ba sbyong ba dang*// sangs rgyas zhing rnams dag pa dang*// sems can yongs su smin par byed// zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa yis// sems dang 'chi ba sbyong ba dang*// nang gi sa dang lam bgrod nas// ting 'dzin ye shes mngon du byed// gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang dang ni// mngon spyod sogs pa'i thabs mang pos// tshe ring ba dang nad med dang*// shes rab rnam par spel ba yis// lam gyi yan lag rdzogs byed pa// thabs mang pa zhes brjod pa yin// ji ltar sngags kyis byin brlabs pas// dug kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur ba ltar// thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis// nyon mongs rnams dang 'dod yon kun// yang dag lam du yongs bsgyur nas// bde ba kun la longs spyod pa// dka' ba med pa'i khyad par yin// sngags dang sman dang ting 'dzin gyis// tshe yi dngos grub bsgrubs nas ni// rig 'dzin tshe dang lus bzang pos// tshogs gnyis myur du 'dum byas nas// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob byed pas// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas zhes// myur du 'grub pa'i khyad par yin// de dag gi yang don bsdu na// dbang bskur ba yi gzhir brten nas// rim gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa yis// sa ni bcu gnyis rab bgrod nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba// bcu gsum pa ni thob 'gyur ba// 'di dag sngags kyi rnam gzhag yin// de phyir dbang bskur shin tu gces// dad dang 'dun pa rab ldan zhing*// bsgrub pa snying por byed pa yi// ri khrod bsten pa tshul gzhon gyis// gsol ba btab nas 'phags pas sbyar// dge bas gsol ba 'debs byed pas// gtso byas sems can thams cad kyis// theg pa gnyis kyi tshul zhugs nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog

/theg pa rnam par dbye ba mdor bsdus pa 'di ni 'phags pas/ me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la/ mdo khams kyi sa'i cha zla snying mar me mdo zhes bya bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
